strap: A daily dispatch from the world you are entering

lead.title: An estate manager earns up to GBP 220,000 in London and USD 425,000 in the United States, but the figures are not built the same way, Oplu's 2026 salary guide shows
lead.standfirst: The staffing agency's benchmark, updated on 9 October, sets out what private households pay across the UK, the US, Monaco and Switzerland, and how much of the number is really accommodation, bonus or tax.
lead.body:
Oplu, a household staffing agency, published its Private Staff Salary Guide 2026 in April and updated it on 9 October. For the estate manager, the role at the summit of a private household, it gives a UK range of GBP 110,000 to GBP 220,000 or more, a US range of USD 160,000 to USD 425,000 or more including accommodation and bonuses, and, for Monaco and the South of France, EUR 8,500 to EUR 16,000 net a month plus accommodation and bonuses. The width of each range is the first lesson: the title covers everything from a single country house to a multi-property portfolio.

Below the estate manager the guide sets out a ladder. In the UK a house manager of a single significant residence is quoted at GBP 75,000 to GBP 115,000, a butler at GBP 65,000 to GBP 105,000 and a head butler of a large principal residence at GBP 95,000 to GBP 150,000. A private chef earns GBP 65,000 to GBP 125,000, while a head chef in a principal household reaches GBP 110,000 to GBP 190,000 or more. A senior career nanny, Norland-trained and working for an ultra-high-net-worth family, is quoted at GBP 95,000 to GBP 140,000 or more. In the US, a butler in a principal residence is quoted at USD 110,000 to USD 190,000, a private chef at USD 130,000 to USD 270,000 or more and a private chauffeur at USD 85,000 to USD 140,000.

The Riviera figures need translating. Oplu notes that tax-adjusted gross figures in Monaco and the South of France are often 20 to 40 per cent higher than the net sums quoted, and estimates that a housekeeper paid EUR 5,000 net a month implies an employer cost of roughly EUR 85,000 to EUR 95,000 a year. In Switzerland, where the guide quotes monthly sums without saying whether they are gross or net, a housekeeper is placed at CHF 5,500 to CHF 8,500 and a butler or chef at CHF 7,500 to CHF 13,000.

The guide is candid about its limits. Oplu says it benchmarks against its own live placements rather than published data, UK figures are gross annual and full-time, and the US and Swiss figures do not state their basis. It gives no figures at all for Italy, Spain or the UAE. The ranges are best read as the asking prices of one agency's client list, a useful map rather than a census.
lead.why: A manager who builds a team, or negotiates her own package, has to compare like with like: the currency, whether the figure is gross or net, and whether accommodation and bonus sit inside the number.

articles.title: Manhattan buyers signed 55 contracts on homes asking USD 4 million or more in two weeks, against a ten-year average of 47
articles.body:
Realtor.com, citing weekly data from Olshan Realty, reported on 12 October that 55 contracts were signed for Manhattan homes asking USD 4 million or more across the two weeks ending 4 and 11 October. The ten-year average for the same early-October stretch is 47. The latest week produced 25 contracts, and the week before it produced 30, the highest weekly total in nearly four months.

The figures describe signed contracts, not completed closings, so final prices may differ from asking prices and some deals may still fall through. They are best read as a measure of appetite at the top of the market rather than of money already changed hands. Corcoran's third-quarter report, as summarised by a New York real estate lender, recorded a 9 per cent year-on-year increase in completed Manhattan home sales.

For anyone who runs a principal's New York base, a busier autumn market matters in practical ways. A family buying or selling means surveyors, designers, movers, storage and temporary staff, and a household manager is often the person who coordinates access, security and discretion while the deal is live.
articles.why: A property transaction is a household project in disguise, and the manager who understands its rhythm can protect the family's privacy and routines while strangers walk through the house.
articles.src: ARCFE, citing Realtor.com and Olshan Realty

articles.title: A 35-metre expedition yacht will make its Fort Lauderdale show debut as the fair, which runs from 28 October to 1 November, spreads across six locations
articles.body:
The Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show runs from 28 October to 1 November and will host more than 1,300 boats across six show locations, among them Bahia Mar Yachting Center, Hall of Fame Marina, Las Olas Marina and Pier Sixty-Six Marina. Among the charter yachts joining the fleet is Stellamar, an expedition yacht of 114.1 feet, or 35 metres, built by Cantiere delle Marche in 2023.

The specification shows what a charter guest is actually buying. Stellamar has a steel hull and aluminium superstructure, cruises at 11 knots and has a stated range of 5,500 nautical miles at 9 knots. She sleeps up to 12 guests in five cabins, including a full-beam master suite with dressing room and study, and carries up to seven crew. Her toys include two SEABOBs, two Flyboards, four paddleboards and diving and fishing equipment, and she has two tenders, one of 11.89 metres. The listing gives no charter rate and refers readers to a broker.

The ratio of guests to crew is the figure worth noticing. Seven people sustain the experience of twelve, and the same arithmetic applies on land, where a house runs smoothly only when the work behind the scenes is invisible. Boat shows are where owners, captains, charter brokers and suppliers meet in a single week, which makes them one of the busiest weeks in the yachting year for anyone arranging travel for a principal.
articles.why: A show week concentrates yachts, brokers and decision-makers in one port, and the assistant who knows the dates, venues and logistics can plan a principal's visit well ahead of the crowds.

articles.title: The Yacht Rendezvous returns to Pier Sixty-Six on 6 and 7 November for its 37th year, with owners hosting children's club members on board
articles.body:
The Yacht Rendezvous, a fundraiser for the Boys & Girls Clubs of Broward County, returns to Pier Sixty-Six in Fort Lauderdale on 6 and 7 November, according to Megayacht News, which is a media sponsor of the event. It is the 37th annual edition. The first night is a yacht hop in which club members meet supporters and tour the yachts. The second is a gala at which young people share their stories.

The co-chairs, Carla Taylor, Jessica Busacca and Mike Busacca, told the publication that meeting the children is what brings owners back. Mr Busacca first attended as a guest about 20 years ago and became more involved after seeing the children's participation and the friendships among owners. The clubs offer young people skills development and a safe place to go, from computers and basketball to hot lunches, and club members also discuss college and career goals with attendees.

Philanthropy is a regular part of an owner's calendar, and events of this kind are often where a principal's giving becomes visible. The practical work falls to those around the family: invitations, seating, guest lists, tender transfers, crew briefings and the quiet management of who meets whom.
articles.why: Charitable evenings are part of how families are seen, and whoever coordinates the principal's diary needs to treat them as carefully as any business commitment.

briefs.t: Monaco employer costs run well above the net salary
briefs.b: Oplu estimates that a housekeeper on EUR 5,000 net a month in Monaco costs an employer roughly EUR 85,000 to EUR 95,000 a year once tax adjustments are included. The agency says gross figures are often 20 to 40 per cent higher than net.

briefs.t: Switzerland quotes butlers and chefs at CHF 7,500 to CHF 13,000 a month
briefs.b: The same guide puts Swiss housekeepers at CHF 5,500 to CHF 8,500 a month. It does not say whether the Swiss figures are gross or net.

briefs.t: A charter broker flags a payments disruption at OneFlight
briefs.b: Amalfi Jets, a charter broker, says OneFlight suffered a service disruption affecting payments and bookings in September, and that its current status is unconfirmed. The broker's October outlook covers Van Nuys, Teterboro, Miami-Opa-locka and Dallas Love Field.
